whatItIs.statement: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

whenToUse.statement: Use Pagination when a collection or result set is split across discrete pages.

howToUse.statement: Compose Pagination with PaginationContent and PaginationItem children containing page links, previous/next links, or PaginationEllipsis.
Set isActive on the current PaginationLink so it receives current-page semantics.

options.statement: Use only PaginationPrevious and PaginationNext for an icons-only or compact pagination control.
PaginationPrevious and PaginationNext expose a text prop for localized visible labels; override aria-label as needed for localized accessible labels.
